title: Statistics
subtitle: Understanding Data, Presentation, and Measures of Central Tendency
subject: Mathematics
author: AI Assistant
learning_outcomes: Understand the collection and presentation of data.
Construct grouped and ungrouped frequency distribution tables.
Represent data graphically using bar graphs, histograms, and frequency polygons.
Calculate measures of central tendency: mean, median, and mode for ungrouped data.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the basics of statistical data handling and graphical representation.
common_misconceptions: Forgetting to arrange data in ascending/descending order before finding the median.
Misinterpreting class intervals and class limits.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always check if the data is continuous before drawing a histogram.
